# Course Overview

**Title:** Applied Biostatistics with R\
**Format:** Online, cohort-based\
**Duration:** 2 weeks, 8 sessions, 2 hours per session, 16 contact hours\
**Dates:** 07/09/2026 – 20/09/2026\
**Days:** Monday, Wednesday, Friday (18h00 to 20h00), Sunday (10h00 to 12h00)\
**Time:** Morocco time\
**Price:** 150€ (1500 MAD)\
**Instructor:** Imad EL BADISY, PhD\
**Contact:** [elbadisyimad@gmail.com](mailto:elbadisyimad@gmail.com) | [elbadisyimad.com](https://elbadisyimad.com)

## Course Description

`BIOSTATR` provides a practical and rigorous introduction to applied biostatistics for health research using R. It covers the full analytical workflow: study questions, data types, descriptive statistics, visualization, inference, regression models, survival analysis, diagnostic accuracy, missing data, causal thinking, and reproducible reporting with Quarto.

The course emphasizes estimation, interpretation, reproducibility, and appropriate use of statistical methods in clinical research.

## Target Audience

Clinicians, biomedical researchers, PhD students, public health professionals, and analysts. No advanced statistics background required.

## Prerequisites

Basic computer literacy. No prior R experience required; R and RStudio setup is covered in Session 1.

## Learning Objectives

By the end of `BIOSTATR`, participants will be able to:

1. formulate health research questions in statistical terms;
2. identify study designs and variable types;
3. organize reproducible analyses using R and Quarto;
4. summarize and visualize health data appropriately;
5. interpret confidence intervals, p-values, and effect estimates;
6. compare groups using suitable statistical tests;
7. fit and interpret linear and logistic regression models;
8. understand the basics of survival analysis and diagnostic accuracy;
9. recognize issues related to missing data and causal thinking;
10. produce a reproducible statistical report.

# Detailed Schedule

| No. | Week | Date | Time | Topic | Main Content |
|---:|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 | 07/09/2026 (Mon) | 18h00-20h00 | Introduction to Biostatistics, Study Design & Reproducible R/Quarto Workflow | Role of biostatistics, study designs, data types, bias, confounding, R basics, RStudio projects, Quarto workflow |
| 2 | 1 | 09/09/2026 (Wed) | 18h00-20h00 | Descriptive Statistics & Data Visualization | Central tendency, dispersion, frequencies, missing values, Table 1, distribution plots, uncertainty visualization |
| 3 | 1 | 11/09/2026 (Fri) | 18h00-20h00 | Estimation, Statistical Inference & Group Comparisons | Sampling, confidence intervals, p-values, effect sizes, t-test, Wilcoxon, chi-square, Fisher, ANOVA, Kruskal-Wallis |
| 4 | 1 | 13/09/2026 (Sun) | 10h00-12h00 | Correlation and Linear Regression | Pearson/Spearman correlation, simple and multiple linear regression, diagnostics |
| 5 | 2 | 14/09/2026 (Mon) | 18h00-20h00 | Logistic Regression and GLMs | Binary outcomes, odds ratios, adjusted models, discrimination, calibration |
| 6 | 2 | 16/09/2026 (Wed) | 18h00-20h00 | Survival Analysis and Diagnostic Accuracy | Kaplan-Meier, censoring, Cox model, sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV, ROC curves |
| 7 | 2 | 18/09/2026 (Fri) | 18h00-20h00 | Missing Data, Causal Thinking, Sample Size & Reporting | MCAR/MAR/MNAR, multiple imputation, DAGs, confounding, power, reporting guidelines |
| 8 | 2 | 20/09/2026 (Sun) | 10h00-12h00 | Final Synthesis and Mini-Project | Complete analysis workflow, interpretation, Quarto report, participant presentations |

# Course Materials

- Slides and self-contained notebooks distributed before each session
- R scripts, datasets, and exercises (shared repository)
- Exercises reviewed and corrected during sessions

# Assessment

Each course ends with a short reproducible Quarto report or mini-project, presented and discussed in Session 8.

# About the Instructor

Imad EL BADISY, PhD, is a biostatistician working on statistical and machine learning methods for health data, with a focus on survival analysis. Full profile, publications, and R packages: [elbadisyimad.com](https://elbadisyimad.com)

# Policies

**Language:** Teaching in French, with English for statistical and methodological terminology.\
**Software:** R ($\geq$ 4.4) and RStudio required; setup covered in Session 1.\
**Attendance:** Full attendance at all 8 sessions is recommended given the cumulative structure.
